title: St Andrews study finds magnetic signature of repeated lightning strikes at Callanish

tellings.quote: research project by the University of St. Andrews where they did a geoysical analysis of a stone circle called the Kanish or Kalinase stone circle

plain: A study by the University of St Andrews is said to have found, at the Callanish stone circle in Scotland, a magnetic signature left by lightning striking the stones again and again. Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien showed him the true purpose of the pyramids, tells Michels of the university's "geophysical analysis of a stone circle", without naming the paper. For Drumm, it would mean the ancient builders chose or used such sites for their electrical activity.
